The featured image was obtained with NASA ‘s James Webb Space Telescope and shows a dust pillar in the Carina Nebula inside our Galaxy , roughly 7500 light-years away. It is formed by interstellar gas and dust , and shaped by powerful stellar winds and radiation from neighboring stars like the nearby Eta Carinae stellar system which is more luminous than 5 million suns. The star formation inside the pillar is excavating its head, creating the open lid of the chest. Astronomers estimate that there are about 70 stars in a compact cluster inside the pillar. items.title: There’s a serious security fix hiding in Google’s September Pixel update
items.summary: Google has acknowledged that hackers may have already exploited this Pixel security vulnerability.
items.body: Credit: Adamya Sharma / Android Authority TL;DR Google’s September Pixel security update patches a cellular modem vulnerability that may have been used in limited, targeted attacks. CVE-2026-58704 could allow a remote attacker to bypass permission checks and escalate privileges without requiring any interaction from the victim. CISA has added the flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities list. Google just released the September Pixel Drop , alongside details of its monthly security fixes for Pixel devices. But amid all the new features that stable Android 17 QPR1 brings, one security flaw may have gone unnoticed. Google and other relevant authorities have now confirmed that a Pixel modem vulnerability, which has now been patched, was used in targeted exploitation.

items.title: هل يغيب عن موقعة إشبيلية؟.. سر استبدال خوان جارسيا في ليلة سباعية برشلونة
items.summary: برشلونة سحق ضيفه راسينج بسباعية
items.body: برشلونة سحق ضيفه راسينج بسباعية كشف تقرير صحفي، عن سر استبدال خوان جارسيا، حارس برشلونة بعد الشوط الأول من مباراة البارسا، وراسينج سانتاندير، مساء اليوم الأربعاء، في الدوري الإسباني. واكتسح برشلونة ضيفه راسينج سانتاندير، بفوز عريض قوامه 7-2، في المباراة التي أقيمت على ملعب "سبوتيفاي كامب نو". وقالت صحيفة " آس "، إن لقطة غريبة أجبرت خوان جارسيا على الخروج من المباراة، ففي اللحظات الأخيرة من الشوط الأول، وبينما كان يحاول استعادة كرة خرجت من الملعب، انزلق حارس المرمى الكتالوني على العشب الصناعي المبتل ، مما أدى إلى حركة غير طبيعية والتواء طفيف في كاحله. يمكنكم مناقشة الموضوعات والأخبار بشكل أعمق في منتديات كووورة ولتجنب المزيد من المشاكل، قرر المدير الفني، هانز فليك إبقاءه على مقاعد البدلاء وإشراك الحارس البولندي فويتشيك تشيزني.  واضطر الحارس البديل للعمل بجد بين الشوطين للإحماء في ظل الأمطار الغزيرة التي هطلت في برشلونة. في البداية، تشير كل الدلائل إلى أنه أمر بسيط ولن يمنع خوان جارسيا من التواجد يوم السبت المقبل في مباراة إشبيلية على ملعب سانشيز بيزخوان. لكن التأكيد الرسمي سيصدر خلال الساعات المقبلة، حيث سيخضع جارسيا لفحوصات جديدة.

items.summary: الزابيري يواصل التوهج
items.body: الزابيري يواصل التوهج واصل المغربي ياسر الزابيري، مهاجم راسينج سانتاندير، تألقه في الدوري الإسباني، رغم خسارة فريقه القاسية على يد برشلونة. راسينج تلقى خسارة عريضة بنتيجة 2-7 على يد مضيفه برشلونة بملعب "سبوتيفاي كامب نو" مساء اليوم الأربعاء ضمن الجولة السادسة من الليجا. ورغم ذلك، برز الزابيري، الذي دخل بديلًا في الشوط الثاني، وسجل هدفًا لفريقه مستغلًا خطأ كارثيًا من الحارس البديل فويتشيك تشيزني، الذي دخل بدوره بين الشوطين على حساب خوان جارسيا. واستغل الزابيري تباطؤ تشيزني أمام المرمى في الدقيقة 65 من زمن المباراة، ليسجل هدف راسينج الثاني. 😲 خطأ كارثي من تشيزني يكلّف برشلونة الهدف الثاني #الدوري_الإسباني pic.twitter.com/h9uyOaJxwp — beIN SPORTS (@beINSPORTS) September 16, 2026 وسجل الزابيري، صاحب الـ21 عامًا، هدفه السادس في 6 مباريات بالليجا هذا الموسم، في سلسلة مميزة للنجم المغربي. وجاءت أهداف الزابيري بواقع 3 (هاتريك) ضد إلتشي في الجولة الثالثة، وثنائية ضد ألافيس في الجولة الخامسة، قبل أن يسجل هدفه اليوم ضد البارسا في الجولة السادسة. يذكر أن الزابيري لعب مباراة دولية واحدة بقميص المغرب ضد بوروندي في مايو الماضي.

items.summary: Keeping unauthorized users from messing with your phone.
items.body: TL;DR Android Canary 2609 for Pixel 6a through Pixel 10 models. Users can now try out Quick Settings lock options, preventing access on locked handsets. Download links appear a little broken ATM, so you may want to try again a little later today. Google just closed the door on one chapter of Android early access testing, as we finally got the stable release of Android 17 QPR1 yesterday. But that’s just one corner of the multi-faceted testing program, and today we see Google making fresh progress in another direction, as we get our hands on the very latest Android Canary build. It’s been a little over a month now since the release of the August Canary , but Google’s now ready to share September’s Android Canary 2609.

items.summary: البرازيلي على القمة مجددًا
items.body: البرازيلي على القمة مجددًا لم يغب البرازيلي رافينيا، مهاجم برشلونة، طويلًا عن صدارة الهدّافين في الدوري الإسباني، حيث استعاد مكانه بعد 24 ساعة فقط من صعود كيليان مبابي، نجم ريال مدريد، إلى القمة. وسجل رافينيا 3 أهداف "هاتريك" لبرشلونة في مرمى راسينج سانتاندير، في المباراة التي أقيمت مساء اليوم الأربعاء ضمن الجولة السادسة من الدوري الإسباني. ورفع النجم البرازيلي رصيده الإجمالي في المسابقة هذا الموسم إلى 9 أهداف، ليستعيد صدارة الهدّافين، بفارق هدفين عن مبابي، الذي سجل هدفه السابع مساء أمس الثلاثاء في شباك إلتشي. وجاءت أهداف رافينيا بواقع 3 أهداف ضد راسينج، وهدفين أمام كل من إلتشي، ورايو فاليكانو، وهدف ضد كل من أتلتيك بيلباو، وفالنسيا، بينما غاب عن التسجيل أمام ليفانتي.

items.title: Spotify bug is preventing users from following and blocking each other
items.summary: Can't follow or block anyone on Spotify right now? You’re not alone.
items.body: Credit: Rita El Khoury / Android Authority TL;DR Spotify users are reporting that they are unable to follow/unfollow other accounts. Users are also getting an error message when trying to block/unblock other users. Spotify says it is aware of the issue, but can’t provide a timeframe for when it will be addressed. Spotify is in the middle of rolling out a new toggle that will save parents’ personal recommendations from getting contaminated by kids’ music. Coincidentally, it looks like a separate feature broke right after this toggle was announced. What’s worse is that it may take a while before this feature is fixed. Spotify users are reporting that they are unable to follow and unfollow other accounts on the platform. As one user describes the situation, when they tap the follow button, the button state changes to “Following,” as it should. However, the follower count does not change and when the page is refreshed, the button reverts to “Follow.”

items.body: TL;DR Samsung has officially begun rolling out stable One UI 9 to the Galaxy S26 series in several markets. Canadian Galaxy S26 owners will start getting the update on September 21, while the US still has no confirmed release date. One UI 9 adds features like My FanCam, upgraded Now Brief cards, improved Now Nudge, and new privacy tools. Samsung Galaxy S26 owners in North America won’t have to wait much longer for their Android 17 update. Earlier today, the stable One UI 9 release was spotted rolling out in South Korea after months of beta testing. Now Samsung is making the rollout official and starting to get specific about its international expansion. Samsung’s global announcement says the official One UI 9 rollout begins today, September 16, starting with the Galaxy S26, S26 Plus, and S26 Ultra. Regional announcements show that this is no longer just a Korea-only release. Samsung has confirmed availability from today in parts of Europe, Africa, Asia, South America, and several Middle Eastern markets , including Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Jordan, and Kuwait.

items.body: 5 min read Preparations for Next Moonwalk Simulations Underway (and Underwater) Water sloshing between the land and oceans shifts Earth’s center of mass relative to its geometric center. NASA scientists have developed a new technique using ultraprecise satellite tracking to estimate the displacement to within fractions of inches. NASA’s Scientific Visualization Studio Seasonal changes redistribute enough water around Earth to shift the planet’s center of mass back and forth by fractions of an inch relative to its geometric center. NASA scientists are on the case, tracking the oscillations because Earth’s center of mass is a crucial reference point for satellite navigation and elevation measurements. A team, led by NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory in Southern California, has proposed a way to calculate the seasonal swings with extreme precision. The technique and findings are detailed in a new study published in Geophysical Journal International. The authors paint a vivid picture of springtime thaws, churning oceans, and dense winter air shifting massive surface loads from season to season. items.body: TL;DR Some Google Home users say Voice Match still struggles to reliably identify who’s speaking. The problem can cause commands to fail or personal requests to be attributed to the wrong household member. Google says it’s working to improve Voice Match quality, but it hasn’t given a timeline for a fix. Google Home has had a rough few weeks, from broken automations and outages to Gemini talking to itself . Now, some users are reporting an even more basic frustration: their speakers are failing to reliably identify who’s talking. Complaints have become frequent enough that Google has stepped in, not only acknowledging the problem but also confirming that it’s working to improve Voice Match quality. That matters because voice is still the primary way most people interact with Google Nest and Google Home speakers and displays. In a Reddit thread , users reported having to repeat commands several times before their devices would accept them, especially when adding items to shopping lists. Users can access the feature directly inside the Clock app on their Pixel Watch once it has received the new update. One of the standout quality-of-life features Google introduced with the Pixel Watch 5 launch was Smart Wake, giving users a gentler way to start their mornings. Now, Google is bringing that exact experience to older Pixel Watches. As spotted by Reddit user Broad_Magazine2285 , Smart Wake appears to be rolling out more widely to older Pixel Watches, with confirmations that the feature is going live on the Pixel Watch 4, Pixel Watch 3, and Pixel Watch 2. Apple, by contrast, only started offering support for verified photography with the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max — an entire generation after the Pixel 10 series. However, the company now claims its “Reference Image” is much better than the C2PA standard used by companies like Google and Samsung. In a new blog post , Apple shared extensive insights into how Reference Image works and why it’s better than anything else available to the general public. Reference Image is an opt-in feature that works on the primary camera of the iPhone 18 Pro series. items.title: Google Translate is getting a major offline upgrade
items.summary: Offline Live Translate finally arrives, but only for newer Pixels.
items.body: TL;DR Live Translate lets you directly talk to speakers of other languages, but so far has required a data connection. Google Translate is now adding offline Live support. Conversations are supported between English and French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Spanish, Hindi, Indonesian, Japanese, Russian, and Swedish. Our phones are fantastic tools for helping us deal with unfamiliar situations, but all too often that requires having an active data connection — which can be far from a certainty, depending on where we’re going. That’s exactly why it’s so important to have offline options for some of those most critical tools, like offline support in Google Maps . Earlier this year we spotted Google working towards another new offline mode, as it prepared support for Live Translate without a data connection . And now we’re finally starting to see it arrive. When we last took a peek at Googles in-development efforts back in May, it appeared that we could expect offline Live Translate support for at least English, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, and Spanish.

items.body: TL;DR Google has started rolling out a new Continue activity hub through Google Play Services on Android 17. It introduces controls for continuing tasks and apps while sharing notifications, files, and media across devices. The rollout lands just ahead of the Googlebook launch, pushing Google’s broader cross-device vision closer to reality. Googlebooks aren’t going to be laptops meant to exist on their own, and the more interesting part promises to be what happens when you put one next to your Android phone. Google has spent months laying that groundwork, from Android 17’s Continue On task handoff to Play Services’ hooks for Googlebook setup and experiments that could turn your phone into a laptop trackpad . Now, one of the clearest pieces of that cross-device puzzle is starting to appear on phones. We’ve spotted a new “Continue activity” section rolling out through Google Play Services on a Pixel 9 running stable Android 17. It sits inside the existing Cross-device services menu alongside Call casting and Internet sharing, promising to let you “continue tasks and access apps, media, and notifications across your devices.”

Most other hardware stays familiar, while Samsung promises six Android OS upgrades and security support through September 2032. The Galaxy A07 4G has had the kind of year most budget phones can only dream of. items.body: Credit: Robert Triggs / Android Authority Your Android phone might be capable of far more Bluetooth audio options than you think. You see, most of the time, Android’s Bluetooth audio menu exposes only a small fraction of what your phone and headphones can actually do. For more advanced settings, you may need to reach for your headphones’ companion app or dive into Android’s Developer Settings , where a much wider selection of Bluetooth codecs and playback modes is available. Take my aging Sony WH-1000XM3, for example.
